pred_ddx.label: Drug-induced liver injury with a possible diagnosis of Stevens-Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis due to ciprofloxacin use

Stevens-Johnson Syndrome/Toxic Epidermal: The patient presents with generalized painful fluid-filled skin lesions, mucosal involvement, and a history of recent medication use (ciprofloxacin), which are all consistent with Stevens-Johnson Syndrome/Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis. The presence of fever, icterus, and elevated liver enzymes also supports this diagnosis.
Drug-induced liver injury with a possibl: The patient developed generalized pruritus and fluid-filled rashes after starting ciprofloxacin, and laboratory studies revealed elevated liver enzymes and bilirubin levels, indicating liver injury. The presence of icterus, hemorrhagic lip crusts, and penile erosion also supports this diagnosis.
